title: Why Do We Never Feel Truly Satisfied? (1990-03-15)
description:
Tired of endlessly analyzing spiritual texts without feeling the reality? Discover how to experience the ultimate truth on your nervous system.

Addressing university scholars, this talk bridges intellectual spiritual study with actual realization. Shri Mataji explains the subtle system, Kundalini, and achieving thoughtless awareness. Includes an extensive Q&A exploring mysticism, Eastern vs. Western psyches, and spiritual evolution.

Key Topics:
• 🧠 Moving beyond intellectual mental acrobatics to feel absolute truth and living spirituality on your central nervous system
• ⚡ The role of Kundalini (pure desire) in clearing the ego and superego balloons to open the limbic area for true awakening
• 🌍 Understanding the complementary nature of the Eastern search for spiritual roots and the Western outward scientific growth
• 💬 Q&A insights on mysticism, true enlightenment, and why reading books must eventually be paired with actual living experience
• 💭 Experiencing thoughtless awareness (Nirvichara Samadhi) by finding the silent present moment between the rising of thoughts

“You cannot understand it through your mental activity, but through your evolutionary process, you manifest a new awareness on your central nervous system.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• At what point can someone who has achieved pure desire articulate intellectually what he or she has achieved?
• Do Realized souls ever feel moved to take a leading part in public life?
• Is Self-realization a gift or is it the work of a person over a period of time of maturing?
• What do You think the differences are between the Eastern and Western psyche?
• How can I experience this transcendental power when all my experience is bound by my senses?
• Are there triggers or predisposing factors that indicate enlightenment might be just around the corner?
• How do I surrender myself more and more to realize the state of doubtless awareness?
• What is the role of pursuing texts, books, and intellectual knowledge in spirituality?
• Are there Christian priests among your followers who come looking for realization?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What is the difference between thoughtless and doubtless awareness?
• Is kundalini awakening safe and how does it happen naturally?
• How to clear the ego and superego to achieve spiritual growth?

Have you ever felt that reading spiritual books wasn't enough? What was your first tangible experience of inner silence like? Share below!
